title: preserving cultural heritage and social cohesion: the tukuder festival at al-muttaqin mosque, kendal, indonesia
core_idea: This study investigates the Tukuder festival at Jami Al-Muttaqin mosque as a form of living Islamic heritage that transmits intangible cultural practices—rituals, traditional foodways, and intergenerational participation—focusing on the symbolic meanings of traditional dishes; it employs qualitative methods including participatory observation, in-depth interviews, and document analysis.
tldr: Qualitative study examining how the annual Tukuder festival at Jami Al-Muttaqin transmits and sustains local Islamic intangible heritage through rituals, food, and intergenerational practices.
